findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_url_custom, check_url_sealed, compute_spot_sealed, trust_preflight, trust_assurance, give, diligence_pack, check_url_changes, compute_spot_prices · Private data: research_paper, attest_document, attest_work · Public sink: register_recovery, check_url_custom, check_url_sealed, compute_spot_sealed, trust_report, trust_preflight, compute_history, compute_alerts, research_paper, trust_assurance, agentid_issue, agentid_verify, agentid_revoke, agentid_renew, correct_copy, give, attest_document, diligence_pack, check_url_changes, attest_work, ticker_shelf, farcaster_kit, nostr_kit, rank_the_rankers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_url_custom, check_url_sealed, compute_spot_sealed, trust_preflight, trust_assurance, give, diligence_pack, check_url_changes, compute_spot_prices · Private data: research_paper, attest_document, attest_work · Public sink: register_recovery, check_url_custom, check_url_sealed, compute_spot_sealed, trust_report, trust_preflight, compute_history, compute_alerts, research_paper, trust_assurance, agentid_issue, agentid_verify, agentid_revoke, agentid_renew, correct_copy, give, attest_document, diligence_pack, check_url_changes, attest_work, ticker_shelf, farcaster_kit, nostr_kit, rank_the_rankers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
